hero.caption:
BUILT BY UNION SOLDIERS IN 1863 HIGH ABOVE CHARLESTON AND THE KANAWHA RIVER.  IN 1862 CONFEDERATE TROOPS FIRED FROM THIS SITE ONTO CHARLESTON.  FUTURE PRESIDENTS HAYES AND MCKINLEY SERVED HERE
